title: Craft, music & food on Cottage Lawn
description: The Historical Society's two-day craft festival brings makers, live performances and food trucks together. Sunday music includes James Roberts and Double Chase.
cost: Adults $5 per day or $8 for the weekend; children 12 and under free.
registration: Confirm admission arrangements with the organizer.
family_suitability: Organizer describes a family event and provides child admission.
feature_reason: One local stop for handmade work, live music and food; useful for trying something new.

title: Help care for Oneida's shared history
description: Ask the Historical Society about helping with tours, events, collections, research, mailings or care of the house and grounds. This is an inquiry route, not a reserved volunteer shift.
registration: Use the Society's volunteer form or its downloadable application.
volunteer_tasks: Tours, events, collections, historical research, mailings, building and grounds support.
commitment: Arrange tasks and time directly; no standard shift length established.
source_title: Historical Society — volunteer opportunities and application
feature_reason: A concrete first contact for residents who enjoy history or hands-on community work.

title: Make time for a local-history visit
description: Explore Cottage Lawn by appointment. Ask which rooms or exhibitions are available before arranging your visit; special exhibitions can have different admission.
cost: Regular tours: adults $5; members and children under 12 free. Special-exhibit pricing differs.
feature_reason: An appointment-based way to explore local history beyond a single festival weekend.

title: Cottage Lawn Farmers Market — 2026 season
description: The documented summer market season paired local produce and makers with food and music. This season has ended; no future dates are assumed.
feature_reason: Retained as seasonal context, not advertised as an upcoming market.

title: Find a first connection through parish life
description: Spirit of Hope connects several Catholic parishes, including St. Patrick and St. Joseph in Oneida. Explore its involvement and parish-registration information; ask about current local service opportunities.
venue: Parish and activity location to confirm
registration: Ask the parish contact about the activity and any registration requirements.
faith_component: Catholic parish community. Religious content and membership requirements vary by activity; ask the host.
source_title: Spirit of Hope — Get Involved and parish information
feature_reason: A starting point for parish involvement, clearly separated from a confirmed volunteer placement.

title: Oneida Baptist community dinner — ask for the next date
description: The church invites neighbors to a monthly spaghetti dinner, but a next date and admission terms were not established. Check directly before making plans.
eligibility: The church invites neighbors; ask about details for the next dinner.
faith_component: Baptist church host. Whether the dinner includes worship or other religious content is not established.
feature_reason: An established community gathering with an honest date gap.
action_label: Ask the church about the next dinner

title: Ask about a regional service placement
description: Catholic Charities of Oneida and Madison Counties accepts volunteer inquiries. Ask whether a suitable placement is available in the City of Oneida before committing to travel.
organizer: Catholic Charities of Oneida and Madison Counties
geographic_scope: Regional — not a confirmed City of Oneida placement
registration: Complete the organizer's volunteer inquiry form.
volunteer_tasks: Discuss available assignments with the organizer.
faith_component: Catholic-affiliated service organization. No religious-participation requirement has been established for these inquiries.
feature_reason: A regional option for residents seeking service beyond one organization; location needs confirmation.
